method: Re-checked against the official PDF with pdftotext -layout and -raw plus page renders (scripts/recovery/page.py grid/crop), and the marking scheme where one exists; figure PNGs opened and compared with the page.

checks.reason: The marking scheme (MS page 10) prints '(II) (D) 11V, 1.96Ma' and 'Id = V0/R = 11/5.6 × 10–3 = 1.96 Ma', but the stored official answer silently corrects both 'Ma' to 'mA' (and '×' to 'x'), so the answer does not reproduce the scheme as printed.
